title: Great cheap way to get a new look!
text: Great cheap way to get a new look!. Wanted to lighten up my dining area without buying new chairs. Love these covers. From dark brown to light gray!

product_metadata.title: smiry Velvet Stretch Dining Room Chair Covers Soft Removable Dining Chair Slipcovers Set of 6, Beige
features: Soft & Comfortable: High quality velvet fabric chair slipcovers, super soft and comfortable, dress up your dining room chairs to create a great new look
Perfect Fit: Stretchy thicken material recovers quickly, secure fit with sewn-in elastic hem, fit most armless chairs perfectly and stays up
Chair Protector: Velvet chair covers make your chair clean and comfortable, protect your chair from spills, wear and tear. Great for homes with kids and pets

Suitable Size: Back Height: 18-24inch (45-60cm); Back Width: 14-19inch (35cm-48cm); Seat Length: 15-18inch (38-46cm); Seat Width: 15-18inch (38-46cm); Seat Height 1.5-4inch (4cm-10cm); Our chair covers can be used in bedroom, kitchen, dining room, living-room, hotel, etc.
